sources.title: Amazon Associates Program Operating Agreement (Updated 2025-10-15)
sources.what: §5: 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.' must be clearly and prominently stated on Site; §1: Special Links must use tagged formats

sources.title: Amazon Associates Program Policies (Updated 2026-04-14)
sources.what: Price/availability display only via Amazon-served link or Creators/PA API; no static prices; disclosure + privacy requirements

sources.title: FTC Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking
sources.what: Affiliate commission relationship must be disclosed clearly and conspicuously; closer to recommendation is better

sources.title: Google — Qualify your outbound links to Google (rel=sponsored)
sources.what: Mark ads/paid placements with rel=sponsored; affiliate links qualify

sources.title: Sell on Amazon — What is an ASIN?
sources.what: ASIN is a unique 10-character alphanumeric code; found after /dp/ in product URL

sources.title: Amazon Associates — Application Review Process (special tagged links)
sources.what: Special links are identifiers (e.g. abcd-20) embedded in Amazon product links; must be embedded on declared sites

sources.title: Amazon Associates — Why do I have to identify myself as an Associate?
sources.what: Link-level disclosure must be clear + conspicuous near link; Operating Agreement statement must appear clearly and conspicuously on Site

sources.title: GitHub Pages documentation
sources.what: GitHub Pages turns a repository into a live website; site URL https://sassnarep3-star.github.io/WinC/
